figure_caption: Protocol overview. A trained model and an explained instance yield one assessed Kernel SHAP run at budget 4d or 16d. Eight independent reruns define the reproducibility label (mean top-3 Jaccard with the assessed run). The self-diagnostic sees only the assessed run and returns r-hat, which is scored by squared error against the label and compared with three baselines and a pairing-permuted control.

panels.title: Protocol overview
panels.short_caption: One assessed run, its rerun-based label, the single-run diagnostic, and the squared-error scoring against baselines and a permuted control.
panels.drawio_prompt:
SINGLE IDEA: one budget-limited Kernel SHAP run is scored two ways — the evaluator turns eight reruns into a label y, the diagnostic sees only the assessed run and predicts it as r-hat, and r-hat is scored against y and against comparators.

OVERALL LAYOUT: one connected left-to-right diagram on a wide (21:9) canvas, in four columns, with two horizontal lanes in the middle columns. Column 1 inputs; column 2 the assessed run (vertically centred, the hub); column 3 split into an upper lane (evaluator side) and a lower lane (practitioner side); column 4 scoring and comparators.

REGIONS (two light grouping containers in column 3 plus the top-left tag):
- R_eval (upper lane container, title 'Evaluator: needs reruns'): contains RERUNS, T3_SETS, JAC.
- R_pract (lower lane container, title 'Diagnostic: one run only'): contains DIAG and RHAT.

NODES (shape = semantic role):
- MODEL: sharp box (data/artifact), label 'Trained model $$f$$'. Column 1, upper.
- INST: sharp box (data), label 'Explained instance $$x$$'. Column 1, middle.
- BUDGET: small sharp box (setting), label 'Budget $$B \in \{4d, 16d\}$$'. Column 1, lower.
- ASSESSED: rounded box (process), the hub and most prominent node of the left half, label 'Assessed Kernel SHAP run'. Under it a small sub-label 'masks · weights · values'. Column 2, centred between lanes.
- RERUNS: stack of eight overlapping rounded boxes (offset cards) as the 'many runs' glyph, label 'Reruns $$\times 8$$' with sub-label 'fresh coalition draws'. Upper lane, column 3 left.
- T3_SETS: a row of two small token triplets (three small squares each, one pair per run, e.g. highlighted squares showing partial overlap) representing top-3 sets, label 'Top-3 sets'. Upper lane, between RERUNS and JAC. If the glyph cannot be drawn legibly, use a single small sharp box labelled 'Top-3 sets'.
- JAC: rounded box (process) with a mean/average glyph, label 'Top-3 Jaccard, mean over reruns'. Upper lane, column 3 right.
- LABEL_Y: sharp box (data, target), important, label 'Label $$y$$'. Right end of the upper lane, at the boundary with column 4.
- DIAG: rounded box (process), the most emphasised node of the figure, label 'Self-diagnostic'. Lower lane, column 3 left. Small sub-label 'jackknife → simulated reruns → prior'.
- RHAT: sharp box (data, prediction), important, label 'Estimate $$\hat r \in [0,1]$$'. Lower lane, right end, at the boundary with column 4.
- SCORE: rounded box (process), important, label 'Squared error'; small symbol beneath it '$$(\hat r - y)^2$$' (the only equation in the figure; keep it small). Column 4, vertically centred between LABEL_Y and RHAT.
- BASE_AR: sharp box (baseline), label 'Always reliable'. Column 4 right-hand stack.
- BASE_HALF: sharp box (baseline), label 'Constant 0.5'. Column 4 stack.
- BASE_GAP: sharp box (baseline), label 'Split-half gap'. Column 4 stack.
- CTRL: sharp box (control, visually distinct from the three baselines), label 'Pairing-permuted control'. Column 4 stack, bottom, adjacent to RHAT.
- A short bracket or grouping around BASE_AR, BASE_HALF, BASE_GAP with the tag 'Baselines'.

EDGES (source → target; solid = forward data flow, dashed = auxiliary / blocked):
1. MODEL → ASSESSED, solid, no label.
2. INST → ASSESSED, solid, no label.
3. BUDGET → ASSESSED, solid, no label.
4. ASSESSED → JAC, solid, label '$$T_3$$ of assessed run' (the assessed run's top-3 set is compared, routed along the top of R_eval, passing near T3_SETS).
5. MODEL → RERUNS and INST → RERUNS: skip as separate edges; instead one solid edge ASSESSED → RERUNS labelled 'same model, $$x$$, $$B$$' (reruns share everything with the assessed run except coalition draws).
6. RERUNS → T3_SETS, solid, no label.
7. T3_SETS → JAC, solid, no label.
8. JAC → LABEL_Y, solid, no label.
9. ASSESSED → DIAG, solid, label 'one run only' (this is the only input to the diagnostic).
10. RERUNS → DIAG: dashed, drawn short and ending in a clear blocked mark (✕) before reaching DIAG, label 'never seen'. This crossing between lanes should be visibly cut off.
11. DIAG → RHAT, solid, no label.
12. LABEL_Y → SCORE, solid, no label.
13. RHAT → SCORE, solid, no label.
14. BASE_AR → SCORE, BASE_HALF → SCORE, BASE_GAP → SCORE: dashed, comparator inputs, no label. (These are compared with the diagnostic: they replace RHAT as the predictor.)
15. ASSESSED → BASE_GAP: dashed, routed below/around, label 'computed from the same run' (split-half gap is computed from the assessed run alone). Keep it unobtrusive; skip this edge if it would cross more than one other edge.
16. RHAT → CTRL: dashed, label 'permute across instances'. CTRL → SCORE: dashed, no label.
The two edges that cross (edge 10 and edge 15, or 4 and 9 if they cross) take distinct colors; no edge may pass through a node.

IMPORTANCE RANKING: (1) DIAG and RHAT, (2) ASSESSED, LABEL_Y, SCORE, (3) RERUNS, JAC, CTRL, (4) the three baselines, inputs, T3_SETS. The diagnostic path ASSESSED → DIAG → RHAT → SCORE and the label path ASSESSED → RERUNS → JAC → LABEL_Y should read as the two main parallel routes meeting at SCORE.

TEXT BUDGET (exact labels, nothing else): 'Trained model $$f$$'; 'Explained instance $$x$$'; 'Budget $$B \in \{4d, 16d\}$$'; 'Assessed Kernel SHAP run'; 'masks · weights · values'; 'Reruns $$\times 8$$'; 'fresh coalition draws'; 'Top-3 sets'; 'Top-3 Jaccard, mean over reruns'; 'Label $$y$$'; 'Self-diagnostic'; 'jackknife → simulated reruns → prior'; 'Estimate $$\hat r \in [0,1]$$'; 'Squared error'; '$$(\hat r - y)^2$$'; 'Always reliable'; 'Constant 0.5'; 'Split-half gap'; 'Pairing-permuted control'; 'Baselines'; 'Evaluator: needs reruns'; 'Diagnostic: one run only'; edge labels 'same model, $$x$$, $$B$$', 'one run only', 'never seen', 'permute across instances', '$$T_3$$ of assessed run', 'computed from the same run'. No numbers from results; no sentences.
